GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
